_sample.label: SANDBOX SAMPLE - read-only GET against a private sandbox stack, not the live system
_sample.data: The sandbox store holds emulated, simulated and synthetic data only (EMULATED camera reads and units, a SIMULATED traffic feed, OSINT situations built from the synthetic capture with fictional *.example publishers).
_sample.notes: The sandbox store is a copy that still holds the 2026-10-18 rehearsal pursuit 4508d86d (opened on an e-challan basis before the stolen-vehicle rule existed). On the live stack the pre-demo reset cancelled that pursuit; on a fresh install a pursuit of a reported-stolen vehicle can be opened only from an approved R_STOLEN_SIGHTING (422 otherwise). The officer name in its metadata is the cast name that rehearsal script used. Opened through the API rather than by the emulator, the row carries no emulator label.
